CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue.d: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CommonStockValue.d: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

CostOfRevenue.d: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

LiabilitiesCurrent.d: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

GrossProfit.d: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

InventoryNet.d: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

Liabilities.d: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

LongTermDebtNoncurrent.d: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.
companyLabels: LT Debt, Net of Debt Issuance Costs

LongTermDebt.d: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

NonoperatingIncomeExpense.d: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

InterestAndDebtExpense.d: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

AssetsNoncurrent.d: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

LiabilitiesNoncurrent.d: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

OperatingIncomeLoss.d: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

Revenues.d: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, after Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet.d: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

ReceivablesNetCurrent.d: The total amount due to the entity within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.d: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries

AssetsCurrent.d: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

Assets.d: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

OtherLiabilitiesCurrent.d: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

OtherLiabilitiesNoncurrent.d: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

OtherAssetsNoncurrent.d: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

OperatingExpenses.d: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.d: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

StockholdersEquity.d: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

ProfitLoss.l: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
ProfitLoss.d: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsInclud.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsInclud.d: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilitiesCurr.l: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
AccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilitiesCurr.d: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer), including liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.
companyLabels: Accrued Expenses and Other Current Liabilities

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.d: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCurrent.d: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset.d: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRest.l: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect, Including Discontinued Operation
CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRest.d: Amount, excluding effect from change in exchange rate, of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertib

OperatingLeaseLiability.d: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

nongaap:FreeCashFlowAltInvesting.d: Alternate FCF proxy using net investing cash flow instead of CapEx alone.
nongaap:FreeCashFlowAltInvesting.reconciliationHint: Broader than CapEx-only FCF; includes all investing outflows/inflows.

nongaap:CashBurn.d: Rate at which a company uses cash reserves. Often modeled as operating plus investing cash flows (negative = burn).
nongaap:CashBurn.reconciliationHint: Negative combined OCF+Investing indicates cash burn.

nongaap:EBITDA.d: Operating performance indicator approximating earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization. Common proxy uses operating income plus D&A when interest/tax line items are not mixed into operating income.
nongaap:EBITDA.reconciliationHint: Prefer reconciling from Net Income: + Interest + Taxes + D&A ± adjustments when building Adjusted EBITDA disclosures.

nongaap:WorkingCapital.d: Short-term liquidity — current assets minus current liabilities.

nongaap:NetDebt.d: Interest-bearing debt net of cash. Uses combined debt concepts when available; cash uses carrying-value cash and cash equivalents.
nongaap:NetDebt.reconciliationHint: Prefer DebtCurrent + LongTermDebt when classified; exclude operating lease liabilities if management defines net debt that way.

nongaap:GrossMargin.d: Gross profit as a percentage of revenue (net sales).

nongaap:OperatingMargin.d: Operating income as a percentage of revenue.

root:BalanceSheet.d: Extensible financial position model — Assets, Liabilities, Equity.

root:IncomeStatement.d: Collapsed earnings chain — Revenue → Gross Profit → Operating Income → Net Income → EPS.

root:CashFlowStatement.d: Collapsed cash flow model — Operating, Investing, Financing, Net Change.

root:Metrics.d: Minimal cross-industry metric set with formulas; extend per project.

core:v12:equity.extensions.d: Attach equity variants here (partners' capital, mezzanine equity, units).

core:v12:metrics_extensions.d: Attach domain KPIs here (SaaS ARR/NDR, bank NIM, insurer combined ratio, scoring models).

companyGaps.label: Interest Income
companyGaps.definition: Revenue earned from interest on loans and other interest-bearing assets.
companyGaps.reason: Material revenue stream for lending business

companyGaps.label: Servicing Fees Income
companyGaps.definition: Revenue earned from servicing loans on behalf of third parties or investors.
companyGaps.reason: Material revenue stream for loan servicing operations

companyGaps.label: Loan Origination Fees
companyGaps.definition: Fees charged to borrowers for processing and originating new loans.
companyGaps.reason: Material revenue stream from loan origination activities

companyGaps.label: Career Karma Income
companyGaps.definition: Revenue generated from Career Karma platform operations and services.
companyGaps.reason: Distinct revenue stream from acquired platform

companyGaps.label: Other Revenues
companyGaps.definition: Miscellaneous revenue not classified in other primary revenue categories.
companyGaps.reason: Catch-all revenue category completing revenue breakdown

companyGaps.label: Sales and Marketing
companyGaps.definition: Expenses related to sales activities, marketing campaigns, and customer acquisition.
companyGaps.reason: Material operating expense category distinct from G&A

companyGaps.label: Depreciation and Amortisation
companyGaps.definition: Non-cash expense for depreciation of fixed assets and amortization of intangible assets.
companyGaps.reason: Material non-cash operating expense

companyGaps.label: FX Gain/Loss & Miscellaneous
companyGaps.definition: Foreign exchange gains or losses and other miscellaneous non-operating items.
companyGaps.reason: Non-operating income/expense item

companyGaps.label: Gain on Deferred Tuition
companyGaps.definition: Gains recognized from deferred tuition arrangements or related financial instruments.
companyGaps.reason: Non-operating gain specific to business model

companyGaps.label: Gain/(Loss) on Loan Sale
companyGaps.definition: Gains or losses realized from the sale of loan portfolios to third parties.
companyGaps.reason: Material non-operating item from loan portfolio sales

companyGaps.label: Restricted Cash
companyGaps.definition: Cash held in restricted accounts for specific purposes such as loan collateral or regulatory requirements.
companyGaps.reason: Material current asset for lending operations with regulatory requirements

companyGaps.label: Loans Receivable, Net (Current)
companyGaps.definition: Net carrying value of current portion of loans originated to customers, after allowances for credit losses.
companyGaps.reason: Material asset for lending business; distinct from trade receivables

companyGaps.label: Loans Receivable, Gross
companyGaps.definition: Gross amount of loans receivable before allowances and reserves.
companyGaps.reason: Component detail of net loans receivable

companyGaps.label: Allowance for Loan Losses
companyGaps.definition: Contra-asset reserve for expected credit losses on loans receivable.
companyGaps.reason: Critical reserve for lending operations

companyGaps.label: Interest Receivable, Net
companyGaps.definition: Accrued interest income earned but not yet collected on loans and investments, net of allowances.
companyGaps.reason: Material for interest-earning loan portfolio

companyGaps.label: Deferred Tuition Asset
companyGaps.definition: Prepaid tuition amounts paid to educational institutions on behalf of borrowers.
companyGaps.reason: Unique to education financing model; material operational asset

companyGaps.label: Prepaid Expenses
companyGaps.definition: Expenses paid in advance for future periods including marketing, rent, and services.
companyGaps.reason: Standard current asset category with multiple detail lines

companyGaps.label: Deferred Commission Asset, Current
companyGaps.definition: Capitalized sales commissions to be amortized over customer contract period (current portion).
companyGaps.reason: ASC 606 compliance asset for contract acquisition costs

companyGaps.label: Restricted Cash, Current
companyGaps.definition: Cash held in restricted accounts for specific purposes, available within one year.
companyGaps.reason: Common for lending operations with reserve requirements

companyGaps.label: Loans Receivable, Noncurrent
companyGaps.definition: Net carrying value of loans receivable due beyond one year.
companyGaps.reason: Long-term portion of loan portfolio

companyGaps.label: Expected Residual Values
companyGaps.definition: Estimated future value of assets or cash flows expected from loan portfolio at maturity.
companyGaps.reason: Specialized asset for loan servicing economics

companyGaps.label: Capitalized Software Development Costs
companyGaps.definition: Internally developed software costs capitalized and amortized over useful life.
companyGaps.reason: Standard intangible asset for tech-enabled companies

companyGaps.label: Content Intangible Assets
companyGaps.definition: Capitalized costs for educational or marketing content with future economic benefit.
companyGaps.reason: Relevant for education platform business model

companyGaps.label: Security Deposits
companyGaps.definition: Deposits paid for office leases and other long-term commitments.
companyGaps.reason: Standard noncurrent asset detail

companyGaps.label: Operating Lease Liability, Current
companyGaps.definition: Current portion of operating lease obligations due within one year.
companyGaps.reason: Material current liability component of total operating lease liability

companyGaps.label: Intangible Assets, Gross
companyGaps.definition: Gross value of intangible assets including organization costs and internal use software before accumulated amortization.
companyGaps.reason: Material intangible asset category combining organization costs and internal use software

companyGaps.label: Accumulated Amortization, Intangibles
companyGaps.definition: Cumulative amortization of intangible assets reducing gross intangible asset value.
companyGaps.reason: Material contra-asset reducing intangible assets on balance sheet

companyGaps.label: Deferred Commission Asset, Noncurrent
companyGaps.definition: Long-term portion of capitalized sales commissions to be amortized over customer relationship period.
companyGaps.reason: Material deferred cost asset for SaaS/lending business model

companyGaps.label: Accounts Payable, Current
companyGaps.definition: Trade payables due to vendors for goods and services received.
companyGaps.reason: Core component of accounts payable and accrued liabilities total

companyGaps.label: Accrued Expenses, Current
companyGaps.definition: Expenses incurred but not yet paid including accrued interest, taxes, and other operating expenses.
companyGaps.reason: Core component of accounts payable and accrued liabilities total

companyGaps.label: Accrued Compensation and Benefits, Current
companyGaps.definition: Accrued payroll, bonuses, commissions, PTO, and other employee compensation liabilities.
companyGaps.formula_expression: Regular Pay + Bonuses & Commission + PTO + Other Compensation
companyGaps.reason: Material employee-related liability component of accrued liabilities

companyGaps.label: Convertible Debt, Current
companyGaps.definition: Current portion of convertible debt instruments due within one year.
companyGaps.reason: Material current debt obligation distinct from standard term debt

companyGaps.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
companyGaps.source_label: Current Portion of LT Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
companyGaps.definition: Current portion of long-term debt due within one year, net of unamortized debt issuance costs.
companyGaps.reason: Standard current liability for debt maturing within one year

companyGaps.label: Due to Affiliates, Current
companyGaps.definition: Amounts owed to related parties and affiliated entities due within one year.
companyGaps.reason: Material related party liability for company with affiliate relationships

companyGaps.label: Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
companyGaps.definition: Long-term deferred revenue from origination fees and other advance payments to be recognized beyond one year.
companyGaps.reason: Material long-term deferred revenue for lending business model

companyGaps.label: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent
companyGaps.definition: Fair value of derivative instruments in liability position, typically related to convertible debt features.
companyGaps.reason: Material liability from embedded derivatives in convertible debt

companyGaps.label: Escheatment Liability
companyGaps.definition: Liability for unclaimed property that must be remitted to state authorities under escheatment laws.
companyGaps.reason: Material liability category specific to financial services; total line with year-specific components

companyGaps.label: Deferred Cost of Revenue
companyGaps.definition: Prepaid costs that will be recognized as cost of revenue in future periods when related revenue is recognized.
companyGaps.reason: Matches deferred revenue pattern; represents prepaid costs to be matched with future revenue

companyGaps.label: Security Deposit Liability, Noncurrent
companyGaps.definition: Long-term liability for security deposits received from customers or related to leased facilities.
companyGaps.reason: Specific noncurrent liability detail; common for companies with lease arrangements

companyGaps.label: Deferred Sublease Rental Income
companyGaps.definition: Deferred income from sublease arrangements to be recognized over the lease term.
companyGaps.reason: Deferred income related to sublease; indicates company subleases space

companyGaps.label: Accrued Interest Payable
companyGaps.definition: Interest expense incurred but not yet paid on outstanding debt obligations.
companyGaps.formula_expression: part of Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
companyGaps.reason: Common accrued liability component; company has significant debt per mapped concepts

companyGaps.label: Due from Related Parties
companyGaps.definition: Amounts receivable from related parties for operational transactions or advances.
companyGaps.reason: Related party receivable; material enough to appear as separate line item

companyGaps.label: Due to Related Parties
companyGaps.definition: Amounts payable to related parties for operational transactions or advances.
companyGaps.reason: Related party payable; counterpart to due from related parties

companyGaps.label: Change in Deferred Taxes
companyGaps.definition: Non-cash adjustment for changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities in operating cash flow.
companyGaps.formula_expression: part of Cash Flow from Operating Activities
companyGaps.reason: Standard operating cash flow reconciliation item; company has tax expense per mapped concepts
